title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of employers' organizations.

description.narrative: Eswatini is undergoing an important period of labour market and institutional reform, during which effective social dialogue and coherent employer representation are essential for sound labour policy formulation and implementation. Business Eswatini, as the apex employer federation, has requested structured technical assistance to strengthen employer coordination within this evolving landscape. In close collaboration with the apex employers’ organisation, the ILO is providing technical and advisory support to enable meaningful contributions to the finalisation of the rules and procedures of the Tripartite Labour Advisory Board (LAB). This support also aims to clarify principles for representation and decision-making, strengthen coordination across tripartite and bipartite structures, and prepare the employer constituency for expanded tripartite-plus engagement. In parallel, the ILO supports employers to engage effectively in tripartite-plus dialogue on key labour market and employment policy issues, while strengthening their capacity for negotiation, policy analysis, and coordinated advocacy. This enables employers to contribute to rebuilding trust among social partners and improving the functioning of social dialogue institutions. In partnership with UNDP and building on previous efforts, the ILO also supports enterprises through practical guidance on the adoption of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) frameworks, including monitoring and reporting, adapted to national realities. The primary beneficiaries are employers’ organisations, their member enterprises, and tripartite constituents engaged in social dialogue and labour policy processes.
